item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russia continues airstrikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure, killing 17 people in Zaporizhzhia and striking power plants in Kyiv, while Ukraine says it will pause its own refinery strikes if Russia ends its energy attacks. Ukraine hit a Russian Iskander-M ballistic missile maintenance base, and Russia arrested a Japanese journalist on espionage charges. President Trump announced a diesel deal with Russia framed as an energy ceasefire, which Ukraine called false after further strikes. The UCDP recorded 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

They also raided Palestinian NGOs in the occupied West Bank and in Ramallah, targeting staff and offices. Defence Minister Herzog says a larger police force is needed to curb violent crime and settler attacks, and Israeli intelligence soldiers disclosed a policy shift that justifies civilian casualties in Gaza. The conflict caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Iranian officials claim some incidents are false-flag operations in response to the UK accusations. The war has already produced 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
